data.description:
## Description
**What**: Update the three test-generation surfaces -- plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md, and the fix-bug RED-phase prompt (concrete path under plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/, resolved during implementation-plan) -- to reference Rule 6 and Rule 7 and instruct the agent to emit the '## Test Intent' header on every new or modified test.
**Why**: Generation-time binding is the mechanism that puts a header on real tests; without it Rule 6 is inert documentation.
**Scope**:
- IN: Rule 6/7 reference plus header-emission instruction in all three surfaces; synthetic verification via a red-test-writer dispatch against a single-AC fixture task confirming the emitted header parses and its intent_id matches the fixture AC identifier.
- OUT: behavioral-testing-standard.md rule text (draft-1); reviewer dimensions (sc-4); the 69e8 negative-examples retrieval block (different epic, different prompt section).

## Done Definitions

- red-test-writer.md, sprint/prompts/task-execution.md, and the fix-bug RED-phase prompt each reference Rule 6 and Rule 7 and instruct the agent to emit the '## Test Intent' header on every new or modified test ← Satisfies: sc-3
- a dispatch of dso:red-test-writer against a single-AC fixture task produces a test file containing a fenced '## Test Intent' block, an intent_id field, and a catches_regression_where field ← Satisfies: sc-3
- the intent_id field in the red-test-writer dispatch output exactly matches the fixture AC identifier ← Satisfies: sc-3
- the tests written for this story carry valid Rule 6 headers ← Satisfies: sc-3
- unit tests written and passing assert that each of the three surfaces references Rule 6 and Rule 7 ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Coordination] 69e8-af39 SC4 edits the same three prompt files in a different section (negative-examples-lookup block); d566 lands first, then 69e8 adds its retrieval section. Merge-window coordination required if both ship in overlapping sprints.
- [Dependency] The fix-bug RED-phase prompt path is resolved during implementation-plan; the surface is under plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a test-writing sub-agent, I want red-test-writer, sprint task-execution, and the fix-bug RED-phase prompt to reference Rules 6 and 7, so that generated tests emit a parseable intent-claim header
